newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BUSINESS LEADER OPTIMISM RISES - POLL.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BUSINESS LEADER OPTIMISM RISES - POLL.

text.p: Optimism among Finnish business executives has increased this spring compared to the autumn, according to a twice-yearly survey conducted by business magazine Forum for Ekonomi och Teknik (Forum) in mid-April.

Seventy-two percent of 183 top executives in large and mid-sized companies polled expected an improvement in the economy, compared to 66 percent in the previous poll in late October, the magazine said in a statement on Wednesday.
A year ago, only around 20 percent expected improvement.
Forum said the number expecting staff increases was now bigger than that expecting cuts: the split had been even in the previous survey.
